In my family we called them Klochkes, they're quick and easy and everyone loves them.

PROS - low sugar, stores well for several days, simple for kids and few ingredients.

CONS - dough needs to cool in the fridge, cookies can be dry if rolled out too much.

INGREDIENTS!

  • 1 CUP BUTTER (2 STICKS)
  • 1 CUP CREAM CHEESE (1 BLOCK)
  • 1 1/2 CUPS FLOUR
  • PIE FILLING (ALMOND OR APRICOT IS BEST)

Set the oven to 375°C.

Put butter and cream cheese in a large bowl and warm or microwave gently until they can be whisked together.

Whisk them together already.

Mix in the flour slowly, mixing really damn well.

Set that shit in the fridge to cool for an hour or more. Plastic it for overnight.

Pull the block of hard dough out and work it over a floured table until you can roll it down as thick as pie crust. Rolling it out and folding it over makes nice flaky layers, but you dry it out as well. Use caution.

Use a glass or something round to cut circles in the dough about 1 1/2" wide.

Put a small dollop of pie filling on the center of each one. Beware putting on too much, it will get liquidy in the oven.

Bake for 10-13 minutes on an ungreased cookie sheet or until golden brown.

Sprinkle with powdered sugar for a garnish.

Enjoy!
